description: This PHP file defines the LeaveEntitlementDecorator class, which provides a wrapper and utility functions for the LeaveEntitlement entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and modifying leave entitlement data, checking date periods, and setting related entities via references.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the LeaveEntitlement entity, providing utility methods for managing leave entitlement data and related entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific LeaveEntitlement instance.

methods.name: getAvailableDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of available leave days after accounting for used days.

methods.name: withinPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the entitlement period.

methods.name: setEntitlementTypeById
methods.description: Sets the entitlement type reference based on an ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee reference based on an employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave type reference based on an ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the credited date as a formatted string, or null if not set.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Determines if the leave entitlement can be deleted based on business rules.
